overview_description.description:
Poll Everywhere is a hybrid work solution that enables audience engagement through live, inclusive conversations. 

It's the largest presentation polling tool. Audiences participate directly in presentations, with polls and ideas visible live in PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides.

In 2008 Poll Everywhere participated in Y Combinator.

about_short_description.short_description: Poll Everywhere is a web, SMS, and Twitter polling service that allows users to submit votes or comments to a PowerPoint or Keynote slide.

product.name: Poll Everywhere Audience Engagement Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables real-time audience interaction through polls, surveys, Q&A, and other response activities integrated into presentations.

product.name: Poll Everywhere Integrations and Apps
product.description: Software add-ins and applications that embed Poll Everywhere activities into popular presentation and communication tools for seamless audience engagement.

product.name: Anonymous Feedback Tool
product.description: A feature that enables participants to submit responses anonymously via web or SMS, supporting candid feedback in various settings.

product.name: Activity Types for Audience Interaction
product.description: Various interactive question formats such as multiple choice, word cloud, survey, competition, clickable image, Q&A, ranking, and open-ended responses for collecting audience input.
